WHAT: Post a manual journal entry for an accrued expense.
HOW: Use F-32, enter account type 3 or 4, cost center 500301, amount 143,871 USD, document text accrual period 006 2026, then simulate and post after owner approval.
WHY: Accrue liabilities before they are invoiced to maintain financial statement accuracy and prevent underreporting of expenses. Manual journals correct isolated booking errors while preserving a traceable audit record.
